title: Strict ordinary quotient pullback tower comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme map $f:X\to Y$, and an ordinary quotient model $M$ [def-trf-completion-unit-models]. Let $T$ apply the actual sequence inverse image termwise, restrict to completed coefficients, and read the resulting complex of towers as a tower of complexes [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. There is a natural isomorphism $\theta:T\circ M\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal T_f$, where $\mathcal T_f$ is the defining integral finite pullback tower [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower]. For every complex $P$ of completed-coefficient module sheaves, every strict complex isomorphism $a:M(P)\xrightarrow{\sim}C$, and finite comparisons $\kappa_n:\operatorname{ev}_n(C)\xrightarrow{\sim}P_n$ satisfying $\operatorname{ev}_n(a)\,;\,\kappa_n=M.\mathrm{evaluation}_{n,P}$, the isomorphism $q=T(a^{-1})\,;\,\theta_P$ sends every sequence inverse-image generator associated to a section $x\in C^i(n,U)$ to the finite pullback generator associated to $\kappa_n(x)$, in every degree $i\in\mathbf Z$, level $n\geq0$, and pro-etale object $U$ of $Y$. Both sides use the specified underlying-section casts [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. This is a comparison of ordinary strict towers; no derived or Roos model is assumed.

For a strict presentation a, pull back a inverse. The section characterization of coefficientSequenceRestriction and naturality of the sequence inverse-image unit carry its generators to the generators for M.quotient(P). Apply the proved level-unit formula. Evaluate eval(a);kappa=M.evaluation on a inverse of the input section, and cancel a inverse followed by a. This gives exactly the displayed generator formula.

theorem ordinaryQuotientPullbackTowerComparison {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E Y) :
    let T := (integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      (coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex
    ∃ θ : M.quotient l E Y ⋙ T ≅ integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f,
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ)
      (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
      (a : (M.quotient l E Y).obj P ≅ C)
      (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
          (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P),
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso a ≪≫
          κ n = (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (M.evaluation n) (.up ℤ)).app P) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : Y.ProEt) (x : (C.X i).val.obj (op (n, U))),
        (((T.mapIso a.symm ≪≫ θ.app P).hom.app (op n)).f i).val.app
            (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
          (integralComparisonRestrictedSection l E X
            ((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).obj (C.X i)) n
            (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
            (integralComparisonSequenceGenerator l E f (C.X i) n U x)) =
          integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E f n
            (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P).X i) U
            (((κ n).hom.f i).val.app (op U)
              (coefficientEvaluationSection l E Y (C.X i) n (op U) x))
